calculation_steps: For any R-fixed state, equivariance of H and incidence gives R-fixed vector field; uniqueness or equivariant hybrid tie resolution preserves fixed subspace.
J transforms under edge rotation; the constant-direction two-coordinate readout has no C3-fixed vector and is zero for all model time.
At A0 seed all three incident edges have u=1 and the rest u=0. Compare rational thresholds; complete incident orbit closure freezes the seed.
Differentiate S_tilde_H using H^2=H and the full generator; uncancelled face term is 2 y^T(I-H)B2 z, whereas full S derivative is zero.
Hold c continuous at H switch and subtract classification stocks; with three y=1 orbit edges a threshold change 5/2→3/2 yields jump -3, not physical energy loss.

counterexamples_and_failures: A deterministic equivariant tie-break cannot select just one edge from a three-edge orbit; imposing a label preference is an external breaker.
At tau=1/2 the naive local strain rule closes all three contacts and freezes the A0 seed, rather than generating N7-specific response.
A non-invariant initial packet or external directional field can yield nonzero readout; the no-go does not apply outside its premise.
A stochastic realization may break symmetry although its invariant ensemble mean cannot select a fixed direction.
Q167's 0/1 masked stock is not automatically conserved in the full 0/1/2 system with unmasked B2.
